title: Months Outstanding and the C&I Index Line Carrying Rate
content:
**Q. Under Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts, what rule governs carrying rate in index line corrections?**

A. The index line carrying rate follows the months outstanding, the whole months from the index line's posted date to the handling date: 6 months or more give 0.06, at least one month but fewer than 6 give 0.03, and less than one whole month gives none.

## Questions answered

**How are the months outstanding counted?** In calendar months from the index line's posted date to the handling date, a month being complete on the same day of the month as the posted date.

**What rate applies at each count?**

| Months outstanding | Carrying rate |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.06 |
| 1 to 5 | 0.03 |
| less than 1 | none |

**Where do the bands break?** With a handling date of 4 October 2026: a line posted 4 April 2026 has 6 months outstanding (0.06); posted 5 April 2026, 5 months (0.03); posted 4 September 2026, 1 month (0.03); posted 5 September 2026, none.
